name: Apprentice
ability1:
You may choose a dead player & learn their role.
If it’s a guest, become it.

name: Doctor
ability1:
Choose a player. Tonight, they’re immortal & wise.
(Not yourself or the same player twice in a row.)

name: Gnome
ability1:
You’re perceived as an out-of-play spirit.
If you die, the spirit may wake twice tonight.

name: Guest of Honour
ability1:
Everyone knows you’re in play.
If the spirit publicly guesses you 1st try, they win.

name: Glass Golem
ability1:
If 3+ players targeted you tonight, you die.
Otherwise, learn how many did.

name: Investigator
ability1: Inspect a player & learn a non-guest role. It’s their role (unless they’re a guest).

name: King
ability1:
Choose 2 other players & see how many are possessed.
(You get false info once.)

name: Medium
ability1:
Guess the spirit’s role.
If correct, learn who they are. Otherwise, learn a random player.

name: Necromancer
ability1: If the spirit killed you tonight, choose a player & learn their role type.

name: Pyromaniac
ability1:
If you’re exorcised, 3 other players burn, too.
(Not the spirit.)

name: Twin
ability1:
You know a guest player.
You’re linked to each other.

name: Pharaoh
ability1: You’re immortal at night, but players get false info about you.

name: Priest
ability1: If an exorcism happened today, you see whether the Vial-holder was guest.

name: Sacrifice
ability1: If the player being exorcised is a guest, you’re exorcised instead.

name: Snoop
ability1:
Inspect 3 players.
Later tonight, you learn how many times they woke.

name: Southpaw
ability1:
If alive, choose a player and learn a role.
Once dead, learn how many you learned right.

name: Stalker
toplabel: You win with the spirit & know each other.
ability1:
If you aren’t stalking a living player, choose a player to stalk. 
They get false info.

name: Jester
ability1: During setup, choose an out-of-play guest. You have its abilities.

name: Fool
toplabel: You win with the spirit & know each other.
ability1: If you’re exorcised, the spirit may wake an extra time during nights.

name: Disciple
toplabel: You win if your leader wins.
ability1: During setup, choose a player - they’re your leader.

name: Copycat
toplabel: You win with the spirit & know each other.
ability1:
A duplicate guest is in play (you know which).
Its abilities don’t affect the game & give false info.

name: Hadeskin
ability1:
Choose a player & see their role. 
Then, kill a player.

name: Djinn
ability1:
Either kill a player, or you die & the Vial-holder becomes a Djinn.
(Not in the finale.)

name: Adze
ability1:
Kill a player.
If a stranger died today or tonight, you may kill again.

name: Do you want to use your ability tonight?
